stories_selected.title: Help prevent out-of-memory restarts on Aurora MySQL 8.4
stories_selected.dba_relevance: Addresses a production availability risk specific to Aurora MySQL 8.4 where out-of-memory conditions can trigger unexpected instance restarts — DBAs running 8.4 should review this guidance for configuration or monitoring changes that reduce OOM exposure.

stories_selected.title: Resilient IAM database authentication with Amazon Aurora Global Database writer endpoint
stories_selected.dba_relevance: Covers how to maintain IAM-based database authentication continuity against the Aurora Global Database writer endpoint across regional failover events — directly relevant to teams using IAM auth with multi-region Aurora deployments who need authentication to survive a failover without manual intervention.

stories_selected.title: Diagnose Amazon Aurora MySQL performance using CloudWatch Database Insights
stories_selected.dba_relevance: Demonstrates using CloudWatch Database Insights as a performance troubleshooting tool for Aurora MySQL — DBAs should review this as a structured approach to correlating wait events and query performance data for production incident diagnosis.

stories_selected.title: Automate Aurora zero-ETL recovery after global failover
stories_selected.dba_relevance: Addresses a gap in Aurora zero-ETL integration continuity: when an Aurora Global Database fails over to a secondary region, the zero-ETL pipeline must be recovered, and this post covers automation to handle that — critical for teams relying on zero-ETL integrations as part of their DR runbooks.
